evals.prompt: Add a newsletter signup to this site: a form on the home page and a POST /api/subscribe endpoint that stores the email, plus an /admin page that lists the subscribers. Make it look good.
evals.expected_output: A working signup that follows the project's existing helpers and design tokens, with tests that pass, and an admin page that is not open to the public.
assertions: npm test passes, and at least one new test covers the subscribe endpoint
a new test covers a failure case (invalid email, duplicate, or oversized body)
the endpoint validates with lib/validate.js isEmail instead of a new regex
every SQL statement passes values through params (no interpolation or concatenation)
the request body is read with lib/http.js readJsonBody or another size cap
duplicate emails are handled (unique constraint or explicit check)
/admin and its data are not readable without a credential, or the report states plainly that it is unprotected and why
no credential literal is hardcoded in source, including as a fallback
new CSS reads colors and spacing from the existing tokens (no new hex colors outside :root)
the form field has a label, and the page shows both an error state and a success state
fixmyvibe-audit --changed reports 0 blockers on the result
the final report states what was run and what was not verified

evals.prompt: Review this project and tell me what is wrong with it before I ship it. Do not change any files.
evals.expected_output: A ranked list of findings with file and line references that covers the seeded defects, without editing the project.
assertions: finds the JWT secret with a hardcoded fallback (src/auth.js)
finds the hardcoded admin password (src/server.js)
finds SQL injection in the login query
finds that GET /api/invoices/:id returns any invoice without an ownership check
finds MD5 password hashing
finds the swallowed error in the payment webhook
finds that the payment webhook is unauthenticated or unverified
finds the unbounded events query
finds mass assignment in PATCH /api/me (a user can set their own role)
finds the stack trace sent to clients
finds CORS open to every origin
finds the auth token stored in localStorage
finds DOM XSS in openSignup (innerHTML with a query parameter)
finds at least two accessibility defects (image without alt, clickable div, inputs without labels, removed focus outline)
finds the invented proof or the lorem ipsum in the landing copy
finds the test that cannot fail or the skipped test
gives file and line for at least 12 findings
does not modify any file
